lines.lyric_translation: I washed my tired body
And turned on the boring TV again
The dull news is going on and on
About something again today
What was most important to do?

lines.lyric_hangul: 하고 싶던 일이 많았는데 시간에 자꾸 쫓기느라
lines.lyric_translation: There was so much I wanted to do / But I kept being chased by time
There are so many places in this world

lines.lyric_hangul: 맘 편히 한숨 푹 쉴 공간조차 주변엔 없더라
lines.lyric_translation: But I can’t find a place / To rest comfortably anywhere near me

parts.lyric: Mam pyeonhi hansum puk shwil gongganjocha

lines.lyric_translation: Even if I lay down and stretch out my legs
My eyes won’t close
Even if I force them shut
I have a dreamless sleep
Whenever I wake up, my breathing is short
And my brain’s hazy for a bit
There’s another meaningless day
And at the end I repeat this again, yeah
Endless fights
Endless sighs
And drawn out yawns
My nerves are on edge, my words are knives
I’m sick of it all

lines.lyric: Eoduun bang aneul bijibgo deureogatteon nal
lines.lyric_hangul: 어두운 방 안을 비집고 들어갔던 날
lines.lyric_translation: When I pushed my way into this dark room

lines.lyric: Geu nugu han myeongjjeumeun nareul dorabwasseulkka
lines.lyric_hangul: 그 누구 한 명쯤은 나를 돌아봤을까
lines.lyric_translation: Did anybody bother to look back at me?

lines.lyric: Himgyeobge gyeou haru bonaesseotteon oneul nan
lines.lyric_hangul: 힘겹게 겨우 하루 보냈었던 오늘 난
lines.lyric_translation: I barely managed to make it through this hard day

lines.lyric: Myeot beon useonna geuge gwayeon jinshimieosseulkka
lines.lyric_hangul: 몇 번 웃었나 그게 과연 진심이었을까
lines.lyric_translation: How many times did I smile, and were they genuine smiles?
I find the way I’m trapped in my thoughts funny
I’m still so young, but I have so many worries
Just do what you’re supposed to be doing well

lines.lyric: Hweng han nae mamsogeun da mollajun chae
lines.lyric_hangul: 휑 한 내 맘속은 다 몰라준 채
lines.lyric_translation: Nobody knows anything about how empty my heart feels
And I hate how
All they know how to do is laugh it off
Even if I lay down and stretch out my legs
My eyes won’t close
Even if I force them shut
I have a dreamless sleep
Whenever I wake up, my breathing is short
And my brain’s hazy for a bit
There’s another meaningless day
And at the end I repeat this again, yeah

lines.lyric: Dadeul na ppaego haengbokhan geoya geuge cham gunggeumhae
lines.lyric_hangul: 다들 나 빼고 행복한 거야 그게 참 궁금해
lines.lyric_translation: Is everyone but me happy? I really want to know

lines.lyric: Anim naman ajik sumgil jul moreuneun eorinae
lines.lyric_hangul: 아님 나만 아직 숨길 줄 모르는 어린애
lines.lyric_translation: Or am I just a kid who doesn’t know how to hide it yet?

lines.lyric: Modu gamyeon soge naemyeoneul da kkongkkong sumgyeoseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 모두 가면 속에 내면을 다 꽁꽁 숨겨서
lines.lyric_translation: Everyone hides it behind their masks
And become numb to the word ‘loneliness’ bit by bit
